title: Lea Salonga sees potential in musical featuring Asean talents

blocks.text: Broadway icon Lea Salonga expressed enthusiasm for the idea of an Asean musical that would bring together performers from different Southeast Asian countries. Salonga shared her thoughts during the 2026 Asean Inclusive Growth Summit on Wednesday, Nov. 11, where she was among the featured speakers alongside Hollywood actress and humanitarian Angelina Jolie and beauty queen and entrepreneur Kylie Verzosa.
